title: A finitely presented ring map satisfying going down is open
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Assume that $\varphi$ satisfies going down: for prime ideals $\mathfrak p\subseteq\mathfrak p\prime$ of $R$ and a prime $\mathfrak q\prime$ of $S$ with $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q\prime)=\mathfrak p\prime$, there is a prime $\mathfrak q\subseteq\mathfrak q\prime$ of $S$ with $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)=\mathfrak p$. Then $\operatorname{Spec}(S)\to\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $\mathfrak q\mapsto\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$, is open: the image of every open subset is open.
